children.title: Cycle 8 · WAKE✳︎ Research Continuation: Prebiotic Heredity and Autocatalytic Memory

detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Continuation: Prebiotic Heredity and Autocatalytic Memory
detail.summary: Updating research on the thermodynamic signatures of autocatalytic chemical memory and defining error thresholds for informational copying in non-equilibrium systems. Current work validates the distinction between compositional persistence and template-directed evolution.

children.title: thermodynamic framework emergence of selection autocatalytic networks non-equilibrium

detail.reason: Expanding thermodynamic evidence base for distinguishing non-templated heredity from autocatalytic memory as described in Prosser (2025).

children.title: error-correcting codes prebiotic evolution information preservation systems

detail.reason: Investigating how operational error-correction mechanisms, typically applied in digital memory, relate to prebiotic copying fidelity requirements.
